exposure: Previous cesarean sections (number of previous CS, preterm CS)
outcome: Intraoperative complications (adhesions, thinned lower uterine segment, placenta previa, hemorrhage, scar dehiscence, bladder injury)
cohort: 100 pregnant women undergoing repeat cesarean section
finding: The study found a high rate (86%) of intraoperative complications in women undergoing repeat cesarean sections, with the risk increasing with the number of previous cesarean sections and presence of complications like adhesions and thinned lower uterine segment.
